v3_invariants: An ObjectiveContract is an authorization envelope, never execution authority; every trigger yields a MissionProposal that passes normal mission admission.
Effective authority of any objective/learning/allocation/pack action = intersection of lower-layer grants; no layer can widen it (authority monotonicity).
Learning is versioned proposal promotion; production behavior changes only by an accepted version with a rollback target.
Protected authority is never learnable: permissions, spend, secrets, project boundaries, merge/release/deploy authority, grader and evidence rules.
The allocator supplies scheduler inputs only; the V2.3 scheduler remains the single dispatch authority.
Every consequential transition is reconstructible from append-only receipts without model reasoning text or secret material.
Every consequential effect, at every version, passes the V1.7 action boundary and its fences (lease, cancellation, site epoch).
